cartera.cita: I would choose the Ministry of Finance (or Economy and Finance).

primera_medida.cita: Immediate fiscal transparency, a credible multi-year consolidation path, and independent oversight. Publish a full, audited picture of the deficit

piso_social.cita: Scale up the targeted safety net immediately so that the short-term costs of adjustment do not fall hardest on the unemployed and poor.

mas_credito_externo.cita: Avoid new unsustainable borrowing or monetary financing of the deficit.

impuestos_progresivos.cita: Reduce evasion and exemptions that favor the well-connected; simplify and make more progressive the remaining system

obra_publica.cita: Complement with targeted public works or training only where they are time-limited

orientacion.cita: Sequencing, communication, and protecting the poorest during the transition determine whether the medicine works
